description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Talk to your company's Manager agent — the only agent you talk to. Give it work, ask for a report or ask about any department; it assigns tasks to departments and answers. When agent capacity is busy the message is queued (queued=true) and answered on the Manager's next turn. Paper by default: nothing spends money without your approval. REST twin: POST /api/v1/company/{id}/message.

text.description: What you want to tell or ask the Manager (max 4000 chars)
